meta.title: ReBoard: from textile waste to panels
meta.description: Textile waste marketplace, supply continuity and verifiable recovery.

home.headline: From textile waste to panels, every kilogram verified.
home.lead: ReBoard connects the factories that supply textile waste, the panel producer and buyers in one traceable chain.
home.demoNotice: All data in this demo is synthetic. The panel recipe has not been selected or tested yet.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.demoTitle: Sign in with a demo role
auth.demoLead: Ready-made accounts for the jury and the team. Pick a role; each role sees only its own organisation's records.
auth.demoUnavailable: Demo sign-in is turned off in this environment.
auth.demoFailed: Demo sign-in is not working right now. Please tell the team.

supplier.label: Supplier
supplier.desc: Lists textile waste and delivers batches.

producer.label: Producer
producer.desc: Accepts and weighs waste, makes panels.

viewer.label: Viewer
viewer.desc: Read-only access to the producer's records.

panel.title: Dashboard
panel.permissionsLead: Read access comes from the organisation, not the role: every user sees only their own organisation's records and shared ones.
panel.unknownItems: Quantity unknown in {count} records; the total is a lower bound.
panel.chartHint: Use the left and right arrow keys to move between days or months.

impact.title: Impact
impact.lead: The headline figure is the kilograms the receiving side weighed and whose weighbridge ticket was checked. Declared quantities are shown separately.
impact.empty: This organisation has no recorded waste batches. Impact indicators appear once the first batch is delivered or received.
impact.trendLead: Starts in the month of the first record, at most the last 6 months. Months follow Turkey time.
impact.co2: CO₂e is not shown: avoided emissions depend on what the waste replaces, and no verified factor source has been chosen for this flow yet.

supply.title: Supply continuity
supply.lead: Production-ready stock is only the remainder of verified batches. Quantities awaiting verification cannot enter production.
supply.empty: The supply view appears for organisations that receive raw material.
supply.thresholds: Thresholds from the organisation's input: {green} days or more is sufficient, below {yellow} days is critical.
supply.thresholdsDefault: Default thresholds: {green} days or more is sufficient, below {yellow} days is critical.

alerts.cover: {days} days of raw material; below the {threshold}-day threshold.
alerts.coverLowerBound: Some batches have an unknown remainder; the day count is a lower bound.
alerts.need_missing: No planned daily need entered; days of raw material cannot be calculated.
alerts.projected_danger: Even with planned deliveries, stock reaches the critical level on {date} (day {day}).
alerts.stockout: With planned deliveries, stock runs out on {date} (day {day}).
alerts.overdue: Delivery from {supplier} is late: it was planned for {date} ({kg}).
alerts.pending: {kg} in {batches} batches awaits verification; it cannot enter production until the weighbridge ticket is checked.
alerts.stock_unknown: The remaining quantity of {batches} batches is unknown.
alerts.concentration: Supply is concentrated: HHI {hhi}. The largest source is {supplier}, with a {share} share over the last 90 days.

supply.projectionLead: Planned deliveries are added and the daily need is subtracted. Planned quantities are before sorting, so the projection is optimistic.
supply.unknownArrivals: {count} planned deliveries have an unknown quantity and are not in the projection.
supply.hhi: Concentration (HHI, accepted kg over the last 90 days): {value}. Above 1,800 counts as highly concentrated.
supply.hhiUnknown: Concentration (HHI) unknown: no accepted kg in the last 90 days.

market.title: Marketplace
market.lead: Textile waste and panel listings. Locations are district level; distances are as the crow flies.
market.readOnly: The viewer role cannot post listings or offers; it only reads records.
market.results: {count, plural, =0 {No open listings} one {# open listing} other {# open listings}}
market.empty: No open listings match this filter.
market.openOffers: {count, plural, =0 {No pending offers} one {# pending offer} other {# pending offers}}

match.title: Match
match.excludedSilk: No match: silk is out of scope
match.known: Score from known components: {weight}% of the weight
match.none: You have no open listing to compare with

detail.offersHint: Only the listing owner and the offerer see an offer.
detail.noDeals: You are not a party to any deal on this listing.

listingForm.title: New listing
listingForm.recurrenceHint: For a recurring listing the quantity is per delivery.
listingForm.compositionHint: At most 100 in total. Any remaining share counts as unknown.
listingForm.amountHint: If you do not know the price, choose “Price unknown”.
listingForm.location: The location comes from your organisation’s district-level profile.

notices.accepted: Offer accepted; the deal and delivery plan were created.

errors.unauthenticated: Your session has ended; please sign in again.
errors.own_listing: You cannot make an offer on your own listing.
errors.unit_mismatch: The unit does not fit this listing type.
errors.quantity_invalid: The quantity must be greater than zero.
errors.date_past: The date cannot be in the past.
errors.date_outside_window: The date is outside the listing’s availability window.
errors.composition_invalid: Fibre shares must add up to at most 100.
errors.window_invalid: The window cannot start after it ends.
errors.panel_fields: A panel listing has no fibre composition or silk field.
errors.not_owner: Only the owner of the record can do that.
errors.offer_not_open: The offer is no longer open.

map.title: Listings map
map.legend: Each dot shows the listings in one district; the number beside it is how many. Accent-coloured dots with a dark ring are your listings. Tap a dot to open the listing, or the list of listings in that district. The list below has the same information.
map.fallback: The map could not load on this device (no WebGL or connection). Listing locations are given in the list below.

trace.title: Traceability
trace.lead: Received waste batches, their evidence, production batches and the genealogy of panel lots. Every step is written to a tamper-evident event chain.
trace.readOnly: This role can view records but not change them.

notices.received: Batch received and written to the event chain.
notices.uploaded: Evidence uploaded; its SHA-256 digest is in the chain.

errors.unauthenticated: Your session has ended; sign in again.
errors.delivery_not_open: This delivery is no longer open; someone may have received it already.
errors.evidence_not_declared: This evidence has already been checked.
errors.weight_missing: Enter at least the declared or the weighed kg.
errors.kg_invalid: Kg values must be above zero; rejected kg may be zero.
errors.rejected_exceeds: Rejected kg cannot exceed weighed kg.
errors.composition_invalid: Fibre shares must add up to 100 at most.
errors.silk_not_rejected: A batch containing silk needs a rejected kg above zero.
errors.file_too_large: The file can be 4 MiB at most.
errors.file_type: Only PDF, PNG, JPEG and WebP are accepted; the type is read from the file content.
errors.no_inputs: Allocate from at least one batch.
errors.input_duplicate: The same batch cannot be allocated twice.
errors.input_unknown: The allocated batch is not in stock.
errors.input_unverified: Unverified batches cannot enter production: upload and check a weighbridge ticket first.
errors.allocation_exceeds: The allocation exceeds what is left of the batch.
errors.balance_note_missing: The mass balance gap exceeds 2%; add an explanation.
errors.lot_invalid: A lot needs a whole sheet count of 1 or more; density is entered only with a lot.

overview.receivableHint: Planned deliveries from offers you accepted. Enter the weighing when you receive them.
overview.suppliedHint: The buyer's weighing and verification show here.
overview.noSupplied: You have not supplied any batches.

trace.verifiedHint: Verification needs an uploaded and checked weighbridge ticket (D-013).

receive.title: Receive batch
receive.lead: Enter the weighing and sorting result. A field you leave empty is stored as unknown, never as zero.
receive.declaredHint: The quantity on the supplier's waybill.
receive.weighedHint: Net weight on the weighbridge ticket.
receive.rejectedHint: Silk and out-of-scope material. Enter 0 if nothing was sorted out; if left empty, accepted kg is unknown.
receive.compositionHint: Leave fibres you do not know empty; the total is 100 at most.

batch.title: Waste batch {code}
batch.fileHint: PDF, PNG, JPEG or WebP; 4 MiB at most.
batch.noAllocations: This batch has not entered production yet.

production.title: New production batch
production.lead: Allocate from verified batches and close the mass balance: input = output + scrap + moisture loss.
production.stockHint: Only verified batches with stock left can enter production. Batches you leave empty are not allocated.
production.noStock: No verified stock can enter production. Receive a batch first, then upload and check its weighbridge ticket.
production.balanceHint: If input and output + scrap + moisture loss differ by more than 2%, an explanation is required.
production.binderHint: No recipe has been chosen; this is a trial record.
production.sheetHint: 1830 × 3660 mm, 18 mm. Leave empty to skip the lot.
production.densityHint: Target range 550–750 kg/m³. Leave empty if not measured.

lot.title: Panel lot {code}
lot.testNote: No recipe has been chosen or tested; no strength or cost claim is made.
lot.treeHint: Back from the lot: production batch, allocated waste batches and their suppliers.
